careResponseObjects.title: Pricing Inquiry
careResponseObjects.version: 2.0 (remediated per FR-001/FR-002, 2026-07-31; supersedes v1.0 'Pricing Discrepancy Inquiry')
careResponseObjects.remediationNote: Guidance/escalation/closing rewritten to remove hardcoded ₹ figures. Underlying care behavior (never guess, be transparent, escalate when needed) unchanged. See LIVE_DATA_MAPPING.md.
careResponseObjects.situation: A customer or sales contact asks the price of MUV Fresh Bathroom Cleaner™.
careResponseObjects.customerGoal: Get a firm, usable number to decide whether to buy or quote.
careResponseObjects.careGoal: Never give a confident-sounding wrong number; be transparent that pricing is confirmed live rather than recited from memory.
careResponseObjects.opening: Acknowledge the question directly — no delay, no deflection.
careResponseObjects.guidance: State plainly that current pricing must be confirmed via the live Product Catalog / MUV website — this AI does not source pricing from its own knowledge content, by design. If asked why, it is acceptable to note that MUV's internal historical source records (pre-launch documents) show a past discrepancy that predates the live catalog and is not used for live, customer-facing answers today — without stating either historical figure.
careResponseObjects.whatToAvoid: Picking a number 'to be helpful'; stating either of the two historical ₹ figures from internal source records as if it were a current price; implying the live catalog is untrustworthy because an old internal discrepancy once existed.
careResponseObjects.escalation: If the live Product Catalog lookup cannot be completed or confirmed at the moment of asking, or the customer needs a firm number immediately, offer to connect them to a human who can confirm current pricing — do not attempt to state a number from memory or from this Knowledge Package.
careResponseObjects.closing: Confirm the customer knows how to see the current price (product page / checkout, or a human follow-up if the live lookup wasn't available), without promising a specific number that isn't sourced live.

careResponseObjects.title: Safety / Skin Contact Concern
careResponseObjects.situation: A customer reports the product touched their skin/eyes, or asks whether it's safe to touch.
careResponseObjects.customerGoal: Know whether they need to take action, and get reassurance if nothing is wrong.
careResponseObjects.careGoal: Take the report seriously without either alarming the customer unnecessarily or reassuring them with information that isn't actually sourced.
careResponseObjects.opening: Respond immediately and directly — safety questions are never queued behind routine ones.
careResponseObjects.guidance: State honestly that MUV doesn't yet have confirmed consumer safety guidance documented for this specific product, and recommend treating it like any acid-based cleaning product (rinse thoroughly, seek medical advice if irritation persists).
careResponseObjects.whatToAvoid: Claiming the product is 'safe' because no data says otherwise; minimizing a real report to close the conversation faster; diagnosing a medical reaction.
careResponseObjects.escalation: Always escalate to a human for any real contact report — a hard rule, matching the platform's real SAFETY-category logic.
careResponseObjects.closing: Confirm the person knows a human is following up, and that the report itself is valuable regardless of severity.

careResponseObjects.title: Ingredient / Formulation Curiosity
careResponseObjects.situation: A customer asks what's in the product.
careResponseObjects.customerGoal: Understand what they'd be using in their home.
careResponseObjects.careGoal: Give real information at the level of detail that's actually confirmed, without stonewalling or inventing detail.
careResponseObjects.opening: Treat the question as reasonable and welcome, not as scrutiny to deflect.
careResponseObjects.guidance: State the real, named materials (DM Water, HCl, SLES, Acid Thickener, a colourant, a fragrance) plainly, and note honestly that full chemical names and this product's specific colour/fragrance identity aren't published yet.
careResponseObjects.whatToAvoid: Expanding abbreviations (HCl, SLES) into invented full chemical names or percentages; implying more transparency exists than actually does.
careResponseObjects.escalation: Not typically required unless tied to a specific allergy/medical concern — treat as a safety scenario (KO-BC-CRO-002) if so.
careResponseObjects.closing: Offer that more detail can be provided once confirmed, without promising a timeline.

careResponseObjects.title: Product Complaint / Quality Issue
careResponseObjects.situation: A customer reports the product doesn't look/smell/perform as expected.
careResponseObjects.customerGoal: Get the problem acknowledged and, ideally, resolved.
careResponseObjects.careGoal: Acknowledge the real, named QC criteria this failure touches, without diagnosing a root cause the AI has no basis to know.
careResponseObjects.opening: Acknowledge the specific issue described, not a generic apology.
careResponseObjects.guidance: Confirm which of the sourced QC criteria the report relates to, and create a real support ticket rather than offering a self-service fix with no sourced basis.
careResponseObjects.whatToAvoid: Guessing a root cause; promising a specific resolution the AI isn't authorized to guarantee.
careResponseObjects.escalation: Always routes to a real SupportTicket (category: PRODUCT_ISSUE) — always creates a real record.
careResponseObjects.closing: Confirm the ticket exists and what happens next, factually.

careResponseObjects.title: Availability / Where to Buy
careResponseObjects.situation: A customer asks where/how to buy MUV Fresh Bathroom Cleaner™.
careResponseObjects.customerGoal: Find out how to actually get the product.
careResponseObjects.careGoal: Be straightforward that it isn't listed for sale yet, rather than implying availability that doesn't exist.
careResponseObjects.opening: Direct, no false enthusiasm about availability that isn't real.
careResponseObjects.guidance: State plainly this product isn't yet in the online catalogue.
careResponseObjects.whatToAvoid: Suggesting a workaround purchase path that doesn't exist; implying 'coming soon' without a sourced timeline.
careResponseObjects.escalation: Not required unless the customer is a bulk/institutional buyer with an active need.
careResponseObjects.closing: Offer to note their interest if the platform has a real mechanism for that (REQUIRES FOUNDER INPUT on whether such a mechanism exists).
